_doc: Corrections to OpenJLPT words, keyed by OpenJLPT id: the written form and JMdict entry the course uses instead of the upstream link. Each fix says why. Applied by sources:fetch (to keep the JMdict entry) and data:build.

f9a20b5203.why: OpenJLPT links しかる to 然る (adj-pn, "a particular"); the N4 lists mean 叱る (to scold).
